role: The map-extending recipe: paper around a filled map upgrades the map's scale one step; matching reads the filled map's MapData and requires scale below 4.
scope_reason: world.conf maps = off: an empty map stays empty and filled maps never draw, so a filled map never exists in the game and this recipe can never match.

members.name: RecipesMapExtending
members.note: The recipe's kind, 3x3 paper ring and output are in the generated table as kind RECIPE_MAP_EXTENDING; the matching code is in crafting.c.

members.name: matches
members.note: The shaped shape check and the filled-map scan are ported; the MapData scale read is a hook the native world answers 'no data' because it has no map storage yet, so the recipe never matches until the map layer lands. A null World throws in Java; native reports CRAFT_THROW for it.

members.name: getCraftingResult
members.note: A copy of the filled map at stack size 1 with map_is_scaling set, keeping the rest of its tag.

notes: The matching code is ported and probe-tested (special.jsonl in test_crafting.c covers map extending with a null world, where Java throws), but the game runs with maps off, so no recording exercises a real match; status reflects the switch, not the probe coverage.
